passages.excerpt_preview: Oh, the mahars and mangs, you are poor and sick. Only the medicine of knowledge will cure and heal you. It will take you away from wild beliefs and superstitions.

The eleven-year-old Mukta wrote the following essay Mang Maharachya Dukhvisayi (‘About the grief of the mangs and mahars’—mang and mahar are two dalit castes in Maharashtra,) which was published in 1855 by Dyanodaya, an Ahmednagar-based jou
